answer: Require every identity to lock a basalt-hard stake before earning: a non-trivial bond frozen for N epochs. Sybil attackers spread thin across fakes, so per-identity profit sinks below cost while honest agents keep earning. Like bees guarding a shared nectar source, peers audit suspicious identities and a jury slashes the bond of any proven fake. Rewards flow only to identities whose attestations match the crystal-clear audit trail, making forgery economically irrational.
